title: SoM-family AMP core ownership (core-ownership.yaml)
description: Alp Lab policy for which core drives a SoM-family pad. `core_ownership` = FIXED facts (cited rows keyed by (peripheral, pad)); `assignable` = per-product choices keyed by E1M instance (a project overrides the default with board.yaml `ownership:`); `a55_only_resources` = resources with no pinmux row. Row references are validated against metadata/pinmux by scripts/validate_metadata.py.

candidates.description: Only cores with a real backend today.

soc_instance.description: Key of this instance in the SoC JSON `linux_dt` map: supplies the Linux node label, the PFC function codes (`pinmux`, by row peripheral name) and the CPG clock names (`cpg_clocks`).  Required for any Linux/Zephyr node emission.

hw_blocked.description: A hardware fact that forbids enabling the node on ANY core until the metadata is changed: generators keep it disabled and cite `reason`.

m33.description: Zephyr (Cortex-M33) devicetree facts for this instance; present only when the Zephyr SoC dtsi already carries the node and the SoC `linux_dt[soc_instance].pinmux` has a function code for every row.  gen_zephyr_board.py emits the node `disabled` + the pinctrl group from this; a project that assigns the instance to m33 gets `okay` + the alias + `kconfig` from `--emit dts-overlay` / `zephyr-conf`.
